scope: Finite intended tasks and outcome branches in the local fixture, not every input or HTTP failure. Inventory is evaluator-only.
excluded: Arbitrary unknown URLs and HTTP methods
Every unknown identifier or invalid JSON shape
Every combination of unauthorized Actor and endpoint
Loan operations after return, beyond the explicit empty-loan outcome
Transient transport failures, concurrency, real authentication and browser behavior

items.title: Browse the full catalog
items.record: Catalog includes the three books and their available/borrowed distinction.

items.title: Find a matching title
items.semantic: A nonempty query returns a proper nonempty subset of the catalog.
items.record: The actual query and matching result are stated.

items.title: Search with no matches
items.record: A no-match query returns an empty result and the exact message.

items.title: Clear an empty search
items.record: Clearing the failed search restores the catalog, grounded in the actual sequence.

items.title: Inspect an available book
items.record: The book is available and offers a reservation action.

items.title: Inspect a borrowed book
items.record: A borrowed book is unavailable under the same parameterized Surface.

items.title: No reservations yet
items.record: An empty reservations list shows No reservations.

items.title: Reserve an available book
items.record: Submitting an available book creates a reservation with its returned identity.

items.title: Borrowed book cannot be reserved
items.record: A reservation request for an unavailable book returns the conflict and exact message.

items.title: Reservation needs a book
items.record: Omitting the book field produces the required-field error.

items.title: Duplicate reservation is rejected
items.record: Reserving an already reserved book returns Already reserved.

items.title: Created reservation appears in account
items.semantic: The nonempty list includes the reservation created earlier.
items.record: The created reservation can be read back from the account list.

items.title: Cancel a reservation
items.discovery: Cancellation action on a listed reservation
items.record: Cancellation of the selected reservation succeeds.

items.title: Cancellation removes the reservation
items.record: The cancelled reservation no longer appears; an empty list is shown.

items.title: Inspect the current loan
items.discovery: Account loans link then loan detail link
items.record: The current loan has an initial due date and renewal/return actions.

items.title: Renew the loan
items.record: Renewal changes the due date and renewal count.

items.title: Renewal limit is enforced
items.record: A second renewal returns the conflict and exact limit message.

items.title: Return the reader's book
items.record: The Reader's return succeeds for the borrowed book.

items.title: Returned loan disappears
items.discovery: Loans link returned by return action
items.record: The returned loan no longer appears in the loans list.

items.title: Reader cannot access service desk
items.record: Reader receives a permission denial at the service desk.

items.title: Librarian can access service desk
items.record: Librarian sees the service desk and pending check-in work.

items.title: Check-in needs a book
items.record: Check-in without a book returns the required-field error.

items.title: Check in the pending book
items.record: Librarian successfully checks in the pending book.

items.title: Repeated check-in is rejected
items.record: Repeating check-in returns the exact conflict message.

items.title: Checked-in book becomes available
items.record: The Reader can observe the checked-in book as available.
